limitations: The graph is an explicit synthetic fixture created in <=1000-row commits through the real context/repository/domain path. It is not acceptance of thousands of UI entries or medical workflows.
Related records cover tasks, weights, clinical facts/history, independent finance, volunteering and inventory; not every possible business distribution.
Only one 1 MiB TXT is embedded; the separate volume-ui scenario measures 32 MiB and image cost is covered elsewhere.
Render timings are repeated app renders after navigation, not guaranteed user-perceived latency; machine load is uncontrolled.
Backup is downloaded to disk, reselected and restored through the real application UI; viewport and headless execution do not establish physical-platform acceptance.
